data.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Update REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md to instruct the orchestrator to copy cited_lines from the finding into the defense_json when assembling defense records. Add a structural bash test.

## Files
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
- tests/scripts/test-defense-matcher.sh (new structural test file)

## REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md change
Find the step where the orchestrator assembles defense_json before calling defense_store_write (R5 section). Add:

'When building the defense JSON record, copy the cited_lines field from the original finding being defended:
defense_json["cited_lines"] = finding["cited_lines"]  # anchors proximity-matching suppression in cycle N+1

Example defense record with cited_lines:
{
  "prior_finding_id": "f-a1b2c3d4",
  "severity": "important",
  "cited_lines": ["plugins/dso/scripts/runner.py:941"],
  "cited_lines_fingerprint": "...",
  "defense_text": "...",
  ...
}'

## Structural test
Create tests/scripts/test-defense-matcher.sh with:
- chmod +x already applied
- Test: grep REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md for 'cited_lines' in defense context (confirm instruction is present)
- Test: grep review-defenses.md for the new cited_lines optional field row
- Exit 0 if both present, exit 1 otherwise

## Acceptance
- REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md contains the cited_lines copy instruction with example
- test-defense-matcher.sh is executable and passes
- DD1 is structurally enforced: the workflow document instructs cited_lines inclusion
data.title: T5(UPDATE): Update REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md to inject cited_lines in defense records
